problems.prompt: In the Lab Canvas, connecting a neutron source → U-235 target → detector is meant to demonstrate:
choices: Induced fission and detection of products/neutrons
problems.explain: Neutrons on fissile U-235 can induce fission; detectors count outgoing particles/energy.

problems.prompt: To reduce beam intensity before a detector, place ____ on the path.
problems.explain: Shielding attenuates radiation between source and detector.

problems.prompt: If a source emits 40 particles/s and a shield transmits 30%, about how many reach the detector per second (ideal, no other losses)?
